description: Digital partition: encoder RTL and the Yosys/OpenROAD gate-level netlists derived from it. DISCLOSURE: the freshness checks are the hash tripwire only; Yosys/OpenROAD were NOT re-run when stamping (the gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu9t5v0 std-cell library was absent on the stamping host), the pins rest on flow record 20260817-110611-37e197a. rtl/tmds_serializer.v and rtl/tmds_tx_lane.v are listed as sources but have no committed synthesized netlist (DR-0014 moves the serializer to the custom domain).
